today.theme: Disagree constructively and move the conversation forward
today.source: TED — Julia Dhar: How to have constructive conversations
today.listen_task: First pass: identify Julia Dhar’s contrast between seeking victory and seeking progress, then note one way curiosity can change a disagreement.
today.speaking_task: In 30 seconds, respond to a colleague who disagrees with your approach: acknowledge their point, ask one curious question, and suggest a next step that moves the work forward.

phrases.phrase: I see where you're coming from.
phrases.note: Acknowledge the other person before you offer a different view.
Challenge an idea collaboratively instead of rejecting it outright.

phrases.phrase: What would progress look like here?
phrases.note: Shift a disagreement toward a practical shared outcome.
